system-characteristics.description: An example system for diff review testing. Now with enhanced security controls.

control-implementation.description: Enhanced control implementation with automated processes.

statements.description: User accounts are managed through an automated identity management system integrated with HR. Account provisioning and deprovisioning follow documented procedures with approval workflows.
Role-based access control (RBAC) is enforced across all system components. Access decisions are logged and reviewed monthly.
The system generates audit records for authentication, authorization, data access, and configuration changes. Audit logs are sent to a centralized SIEM.
